clusters.pick_reason: PR #2215 is a strict superset of #2214. It applies the same `/\/+$/` regex normalization but also (1) extracts it into a reusable `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper, and (2) fixes a latent correctness bug in `shouldAttemptFallback`: after normalization a root path becomes `''` not `'/'`, so the guard `pathname === '/'` would never fire — #2215 corrects this to `pathname === ''`.
